title: DCGAN Throughput Benchmark: 64x64 RGB (B=16, W=64)
intuition: Standard 64x64 RGB DCGAN throughput and VRAM benchmark measuring fixed-architecture update latency (one D step + one G/prior step) across competing trainer families.
failure_mode: Expensive second-order autograd graphs or large dense linear-algebra solves degrade step latency and VRAM scaling.
protocol_notes: Research diagnostic throughput workload only; no image-quality gate.
